# SEO and GEO audit: acme-mugs The repo is a small client-rendered Vite and React app with 6 files. Problems are listed by severity. ## Critical 1. **`public/robots.txt:1-2` blocks the whole site.** - `User-agent: *` with `Disallow: /` tells Google, Bing, GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot and every other crawler to stay away. - Nothing else in this audit matters while this file is in place. - Fix: replace it with the following. Add specific rules only for bots you want to block. ``` User-agent: * Allow: / Sitemap: https:///sitemap.xml ``` 2. **`index.html:8` and `src/main.jsx:16` render everything on the client.** - The served HTML is an empty `
`. - Most AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot) don't execute JavaScript, so they see no content. Google renders JS, but later and less reliably. - Fix: pre-render or server-render the pages, for example with SSR or SSG using vite-plugin-ssr/Vike, or move to Next.js or Astro. At minimum, prerender `/` and `/catalogue` at build time. 3. **`src/pages/Catalogue.jsx:5-7` fetches the products in the browser.** - The product list only appears after `fetch('/api/mugs')` resolves, so crawlers that don't run JS never see a single product. - Fix: load the data at build or server time and include it in the initial HTML. - The fetch has no error handling. ## High 4. **`index.html:5` uses the placeholder title `Vite App`.** - Every page shares it. - Fix: give each route a unique title of about 60 characters, e.g. "Handmade Ceramic Mugs from Bristol | Acme Mugs" and "Mug Catalogue | Acme Mugs". - With client-side routing you need per-route head management, such as React 19's native `` and `<meta>` tags in components, or react-helmet-async. 5. **`index.html:3-6` has no meta description, canonical, Open Graph or Twitter tags, and no viewport meta tag.** - The missing viewport tag hurts mobile-first indexing. - Fix: add `<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">`, a per-page `<meta name="description">`, `<link rel="canonical">`, `og:title`, `og:description`, `og:image` and `twitter:card`. 6. **`index.html:2` has no `lang` attribute on `<html>`.** - Fix: use `<html lang="en">`. 7. **`src/main.jsx:11` renders the Catalogue nav item as `<button onClick={navigate(...)}>`.** - Crawlers don't click buttons, so they find no link to `/catalogue`. The page may never be discovered, and it also breaks middle-click, open-in-new-tab and accessibility. - Fix: use `<Link to="/catalogue">Catalogue</Link>`, as the Home link on line 10 already does. Then remove the unused `useNavigate` import. 8. **There is no structured data anywhere.** - Fix: add JSON-LD. - `Organization` and `WebSite` on Home (`src/pages/Home.jsx`). - `ItemList` and `Product` (name, image, description, `offers` with price and availability) on Catalogue (`src/pages/Catalogue.jsx:11`). - Product schema is what shopping results and AI answer engines use for product facts. ## Medium 9. **`src/pages/Home.jsx:5` has `<img src="/hero.jpg" />` with no `alt`, `width` or `height`.** - Missing alt text costs image search and accessibility. Missing dimensions cause layout shift (CLS). - It's likely the LCP image, so also add `fetchpriority="high"` and don't lazy-load it. - Fix: `<img src="/hero.jpg" alt="Handmade ceramic mug on a wooden table" width="1200" height="800" fetchpriority="high" />`. - `hero.jpg` isn't in the repo (`public/` only has `robots.txt`), so check it exists. 10. **`src/pages/Home.jsx:3-7` has almost no content.** - The page is one H1 and one sentence. - AI engines cite pages with extractable facts. Add the following: - what you make, materials and capacity - care instructions - shipping and pricing - an FAQ - the maker's story, with a named author or brand and location 11. **`src/pages/Catalogue.jsx:11` renders each mug as a bare `<p>{m.name}</p>`.** - There is no link to a product page, no image, no price and no description. - Fix: give each mug its own route with a unique URL, such as `/catalogue/:slug`, with its own title, description and Product schema. Render the list as `<ul>` and `<li>` items linking to those pages. 12. **`src/pages/Catalogue.jsx:10` uses the H1 "Catalogue".** - It is generic. Use something descriptive, like "Handmade ceramic mug catalogue". 13. **`src/main.jsx:19-22` has no 404 route.** - Unknown URLs render only the nav, and with an SPA host they usually return HTTP 200, creating soft-404s. - Fix: add `<Route path="*">` with a not-found page, and make the server return a real 404 status. ## Missing files 14. **No `public/sitemap.xml`.** Generate one listing `/`, `/catalogue` and each product URL, and reference it from `robots.txt`. 15. **No `public/llms.txt`.** This is optional and has unproven impact, but it's cheap. Add a short Markdown summary of the site and its key pages. 16. **No favicon and no `og:image` asset.** 17. **`package.json` has no SEO or prerender tooling.** Add the SSG/SSR solution from item 2 and a sitemap generator. ## Suggested order 1. Fix `robots.txt`. 2. Prerender or SSR the pages. 3. Replace the nav button with a `<Link>`. 4. Add per-page titles, descriptions and canonicals. 5. Add structured data and product pages. 6. Add the sitemap, alt text and the remaining items. I haven't changed any files. I can apply the quick fixes (1, 4–7, 9, 14) if you want.
